Name: Shape Wood
Components: V, S, M (a pinch of sawdust)
Description: You touch a nonmagical wooden object of Large size or smaller or a section of wood no more than 10 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. For example, you might shape a trap door into a spear or quarterstaff, or you might shape a large wooden throne into a cage fit for a Medium creature.
